description: This file is a shell script for testing interaction with Perforce (P4) regarding case folding and case-insensitive file systems. It includes setup commands, test scenarios for creating repositories, adding files with different cases, and cloning repositories to verify case sensitivity behavior.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a specific prerequisite (e.g., case-insensitive file system) is available.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server with specified options, such as case folding.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configures the client view mapping for the Perforce workspace.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changelists to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expected to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a given file path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
